## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it belongs in this repository.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated a behavior-level test.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes.
- [ ] I inspected any affected SVG, PNG, or MP4 output.
- [ ] I updated commands, dependencies, or output documentation when needed.
- [ ] I did not commit private images, credentials, private URLs, or unintentional generated runs.

## Artifacts

Link or attach a small redistributable before/after artifact when visual output
changes. Describe the alpha-stack shape, ink count, and relevant command.
